Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What are alcohols? Describe their classification (i) by the number of hydroxyl groups and (ii) by the type of carbon atom carrying the -OH group, with general formulae and examples. (4 marks)
(Alcohols kya hain? In ki darja-bandi (i) hydroxyl groups ki tadaad aur (ii) -OH wale carbon ki qisam ke lehaaz se general formulae aur misaalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Alcohols woh hydroxy compounds hain jin ka functional group hydroxyl (-OH) hai jo aliphatic carbon se juda ho. General formula ROH, jahan R alkyl group hai. Methanol (CH₃OH) aur ethanol (CH₃CH₂OH) monohydric series ke pehle do members hain; cholesterol aur carbohydrates bhi isi family mein hain.

(i) -OH groups ki tadaad se:
• Monohydric alcohols: aik -OH group, maslan ethanol, propan-1-ol.
• Polyhydric alcohols: aik se ziyada -OH groups, maslan glycol (1,2-ethanediol, do -OH) aur glycerol (1,2,3-propanetriol, teen -OH).

(ii) -OH wale carbon se seedhe jude carbon atoms ki tadaad se:
• Primary (1°): -OH primary carbon par; R₁CH₂OH, maslan propan-1-ol, CH₃CH₂CH₂OH.
• Secondary (2°): -OH secondary carbon par; R₂CHOH, maslan propan-2-ol, CH₃CH(OH)CH₃.
• Tertiary (3°): -OH tertiary carbon par; R₃COH, maslan 2-methylpropan-2-ol, (CH₃)₃COH.

book_ref.quote: Depending on the number of carbon atoms which are directly attached to the carbon that is bonded with the -OH group, alcohols can be classified into three types.

blocks.prompt:
2 Write the dissociation equilibria of an alcohol and of water. Explain the meaning of a low degree of dissociation and how the positive inductive effect of the alkyl group affects the alkoxide ion. (4 marks)
(Alcohol aur paani ki dissociation equilibria likhein. Kam degree of dissociation ka matlab aur alkyl group ke positive inductive effect ka alkoxide ion par asar wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Equilibria:
ROH(aq) ⇌ RO⁻(aq) + H⁺(aq)
H₂O(l) ⇌ OH⁻(aq) + H⁺(aq)

Kam degree of dissociation: paani mein alcohol molecules bohat thode ions mein toot-te hain. Equilibrium kaafi left par hai, yani ROH molecules RO⁻ aur H⁺ ions se bohat ziyada hain. Paani ka equilibrium bhi left par hai magar woh ziyada H⁺ deta hai. Alcohols ka [H⁺(aq)] paani se kam hai, is liye woh paani se kamzor acids hain.

Alkyl group ka kirdaar:
• Alkyl groups electron dete hain; covalent bond mein electrons dhakelte hain (positive inductive effect).
• Alcohol se H⁺ nikalne par alkoxide ion banta hai, maslan CH₃CH₂O⁻ (ethoxide). Is ka O electron dene wale alkyl group se juda hai, is liye O par electron density ziyada hoti hai.
• Is se alkoxide ion ghair-mustahkam (unstable) hota hai aur H⁺ le kar dobara alcohol banne ka imkaan ziyada hota hai. Is liye alcohol kam ionise hota hai aur paani se kam acidic hai.

book_ref.quote: The reason for alcohols being less acidic than water is the presence of alkyl groups.

blocks.prompt:
3 Compare the conjugate bases of phenol and ethanol. Use the comparison to place phenol, water and ethanol in order of acidity. (4 marks)
(Phenol aur ethanol ke conjugate bases ka muqabla karein. Is muqable se phenol, paani aur ethanol ko acidity ki tarteeb mein rakhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Phenol H⁺ kho kar phenoxide ion C₆H₅O⁻ deta hai; ethanol H⁺ kho kar ethoxide ion CH₃CH₂O⁻ deta hai. Har conjugate base ki mazbooti (stability) tay karti hai ke proton kitni aasaani se nikalta hai.

Acidity ki tarteeb: phenol > paani > ethanol.

book_ref.quote: Although phenol compounds contain an alcohol (-OH) group, they are weakly acidic and this is due to the delocalisation of one of the lone pairs from the oxygen atom into the aromatic ring.

rows: O ka aik lone pair ring ke delocalised π system se overlap karta hai
O electron dene wale alkyl group se juda hai (positive inductive effect)
Negative charge ring par phail jata hai; O par charge density kam
Ion mustahkam; H⁺ zor se nahi khinchta, phenol dobara kam banta hai
Ion ghair-mustahkam; foran H⁺ le kar ethanol banta hai
Phenol proton aasaani se khota hai: paani se ziyada acidic
Ethanol kam ionise hota hai: paani se kam acidic

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe the preparation of alcohols from alkenes (two methods) and from halogenoalkanes, giving reagents, conditions, equations and the type of reaction. (4 marks)
(Alkenes (do tareeqe) aur halogenoalkanes se alcohols ki tayyari reagents, halaat, equations aur reaction ki qisam ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Alkene + steam: garam steam ko alkene se concentrated phosphoric acid (H₃PO₄) catalyst ke saath react karaya jata hai. Electrophilic addition hota hai.
CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O → CH₃CH₂OH (ethene se ethanol)

2. Cold, dilute KMnO₄ se alkenes ka oxidation: yeh halka oxidising agent alkene ko diol (do -OH groups) mein badal deta hai.
CH₂=CH₂ + [O] + H₂O → HOCH₂–CH₂OH (ethene se 1,2-ethanediol)

3. Halogenoalkanes se: halogenoalkane ko aqueous NaOH ke saath garam karne par halogen ki jagah -OH aa jata hai. Yeh nucleophilic substitution hai.
CH₃CH₂Br + NaOH(aq) → CH₃CH₂OH + NaBr (bromoethane se ethanol)

book_ref.quote: When hot steam is reacted with an alkene, using concentrated phosphoric acid (H₃PO₄) as a catalyst, electrophilic addition takes place to form an alcohol.

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe how alcohols are obtained from aldehydes, ketones, carboxylic acids and esters. State the class of alcohol formed in each reduction. (4 marks)
(Aldehydes, ketones, carboxylic acids aur esters se alcohols kaise hasil hote hain, bayan karein. Har reduction mein banne wale alcohol ki qisam batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Aldehydes: NaBH₄ ya LiAlH₄ se reduce ho kar primary alcohols.
CH₃CHO + 2[H] → CH₃CH₂OH (ethanal se ethanol)

2. Ketones: NaBH₄ ya LiAlH₄ se reduce ho kar secondary alcohols.
CH₃COCH₃ + 2[H] → CH₃CH(OH)CH₃ (propanone se propan-2-ol)

3. Carboxylic acids: LiAlH₄ se reduce ho kar primary alcohols, maslan ethanoic acid CH₃COOH se ethanol CH₃CH₂OH.

4. Esters: dilute acid ke saath garam karne par hydrolysis (paani se todna) hoti hai aur carboxylic acid aur alcohol bante hain.
CH₃COOC₂H₅ + H₂O → CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH (ethyl ethanoate se ethanoic acid aur ethanol)

book_ref.quote: Aldehydes and ketones can be reduced by reducing agents such as NaBH₄ or LiAlH₄ to obtain alcohols.

blocks.prompt:
6 Ethene reacts with hot steam over concentrated H₃PO₄: CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O → CH₃CH₂OH. Calculate the mass of ethanol formed and the mass of steam used when 14 g of ethene reacts completely. (Molar masses: ethene 28, water 18, ethanol 46 g mol⁻¹.) (4 marks)
(Ethene concentrated H₃PO₄ par garam steam se react karti hai: CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O → CH₃CH₂OH. 14 g ethene ke poora react karne par banne wale ethanol aur istemal hone wali steam ki mass maloom karein. (Molar masses: ethene 28, paani 18, ethanol 46 g mol⁻¹.))
blocks.explanation: Ethene ke grams ko moles mein badlein; equation 1 : 1 : 1 hai, to steam aur ethanol ke moles barabar; phir grams mein badlein.

book_ref.quote: i) Ethene and steam to ethanol

steps: Mole ratio ethene : H₂O : ethanol = 1 : 1 : 1, to H₂O = 0.50 mol aur ethanol = 0.50 mol

blocks.prompt:
7 Describe the combustion, substitution and dehydration reactions of ethanol, giving equations, reagents and the type of reaction in each case. (4 marks)
(Ethanol ke combustion, substitution aur dehydration reactions equations, reagents aur reaction ki qisam ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Combustion (jalna): aag lagne par alcohols poori tarah jal kar carbon dioxide aur paani dete hain.
CH₃CH₂OH + 3O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂O, ΔH°c = −1367 kJ mol⁻¹
Yeh bohat exothermic hai, is liye kuch mulkon mein ethanol petrol ka mutabadil hai.

2. Substitution: -OH group ki jagah koi aur group (jaise halogen) aa kar halogenoalkane banta hai.
CH₃CH₂OH + HCl → CH₃CH₂Cl + H₂O (ZnCl₂)

3. Dehydration: elimination reaction jis mein paani ka molecule nikal kar alkene banta hai. Dehydrating agents: aluminium oxide, conc. sulphuric acid, conc. phosphoric acid.
CH₃CH₂OH → CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O

book_ref.quote: Alcohols when ignited, undergo complete combustion to form carbon dioxide and water.

blocks.prompt:
8 The standard enthalpy of combustion of ethanol is −1367 kJ mol⁻¹ (CH₃CH₂OH + 3O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂O). Calculate (i) the heat released when 9.2 g of ethanol burns completely and (ii) the mass of CO₂ produced. (Molar masses: ethanol 46, CO₂ 44 g mol⁻¹.) (4 marks)
(Ethanol ki standard enthalpy of combustion −1367 kJ mol⁻¹ hai (CH₃CH₂OH + 3O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂O). (i) 9.2 g ethanol ke poora jalne par nikalne wali heat aur (ii) banne wali CO₂ ki mass maloom karein. (Molar masses: ethanol 46, CO₂ 44 g mol⁻¹.))
blocks.explanation: Ethanol ke moles nikalein; heat = moles × 1367 kJ; equation se CO₂ ke moles ethanol ke do guna hain.

book_ref.quote: The above reaction is highly exothermic; this is why the alcohol is used as an alternate to petrol in some countries.

blocks.final_answer: (i) 273.4 kJ heat nikalti hai; (ii) 17.6 g CO₂

blocks.prompt:
9 A burner must supply 2050.5 kJ of heat by burning ethanol (ΔH°c = −1367 kJ mol⁻¹; CH₃CH₂OH + 3O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂O). Calculate the mass of ethanol needed and the volume of oxygen used at STP. (Molar mass of ethanol 46 g mol⁻¹; molar volume of a gas at STP 22.4 dm³ mol⁻¹.) (4 marks)
(Aik burner ko ethanol jala kar 2050.5 kJ heat deni hai (ΔH°c = −1367 kJ mol⁻¹; CH₃CH₂OH + 3O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂O). Darkaar ethanol ki mass aur STP par istemal hone wali oxygen ka volume maloom karein. (Ethanol ki molar mass 46 g mol⁻¹; STP par gas ka molar volume 22.4 dm³ mol⁻¹.))
blocks.explanation: Ethanol ke moles = darkaar heat ÷ fi mole heat; phir oxygen ke liye 1 : 3 ratio.

book_ref.quote: Alcohols when ignited, undergo complete combustion to form carbon dioxide and water.

steps: STP par O₂ ka volume = 4.5 × 22.4 = 100.8 dm³
blocks.final_answer: 69 g ethanol; STP par 100.8 dm³ O₂

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe the reaction of ethanol with sodium metal. How is it used as a test for the -OH group, and how does it compare with the reaction of sodium with water and with longer-chain alcohols? (4 marks)
(Ethanol ka sodium metal se reaction bayan karein. Yeh -OH group ke test ke taur par kaise istemal hota hai, aur paani aur lambi chain wale alcohols ke saath reaction se is ka kya muqabla hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Reaction: hydroxyl group ka O-H bond toot-ta hai; hydrogen gas nikalti hai aur base (alkoxide) banta hai.
2CH₃CH₂OH + 2Na → 2CH₃CH₂ONa + H₂(g)
Zaa'id ethanol urane par sodium ethoxide ka safed crystalline solid bachta hai.

-OH ka test: sodium dalne par agar hydroxy group ho to hydrogen gas ke bulbule nikalte hain.

Paani se muqabla: yeh reaction sodium aur paani ke reaction se kam tez hai. Phenolphthalein ke saath ethanol mein pink rang aahista aur paani mein foran aata hai.

Chain ki lambai: alcohol ki hydrocarbon chain jitni lambi, reaction utna kam tez.

book_ref.quote: When an alcohol reacts with a reactive metal such as sodium (Na), the oxygen-hydrogen bond in the hydroxly group breaks.

blocks.prompt:
11 4.6 g of ethanol reacts completely with excess sodium: 2CH₃CH₂OH + 2Na → 2CH₃CH₂ONa + H₂. Calculate the volume of hydrogen at STP and the mass of sodium ethoxide left after evaporating the excess ethanol. (Molar masses: ethanol 46, sodium ethoxide 68 g mol⁻¹; molar volume at STP 22.4 dm³ mol⁻¹.) (4 marks)
(4.6 g ethanol zaa'id sodium se poora react karta hai: 2CH₃CH₂OH + 2Na → 2CH₃CH₂ONa + H₂. STP par hydrogen ka volume aur zaa'id ethanol urane ke baad bachne wale sodium ethoxide ki mass maloom karein. (Molar masses: ethanol 46, sodium ethoxide 68 g mol⁻¹; STP par molar volume 22.4 dm³ mol⁻¹.))
blocks.explanation: Ethanol ke jitne moles, utne hi sodium ethoxide ke moles aur un ke aadhe H₂ ke moles.

book_ref.quote: If the excess ethanol is evaporated off after the reaction, a white crystalline solid of sodium alkoxide is left.

steps: STP par H₂ ka volume = 0.050 × 22.4 = 1.12 dm³
CH₃CH₂ONa ke moles = 0.10 mol; mass = 0.10 × 68 = 6.8 g
blocks.final_answer: STP par 1.12 dm³ H₂; 6.8 g sodium ethoxide

blocks.prompt:
12 Describe the oxidation of primary, secondary and tertiary alcohols with acidified potassium dichromate(VI). Explain the colour change, the need for the acid, and how the reaction distinguishes tertiary alcohols. (4 marks)
(Acidified potassium dichromate(VI) se primary, secondary aur tertiary alcohols ka oxidation bayan karein. Rang ki tabdeeli, acid ki zaroorat aur tertiary alcohols ki pehchan wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Alcohols ke oxidising agents acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ (potassium dichromate(VI), orange) aur acidified KMnO₄ hain.

• Primary alcohols oxidise ho kar aldehydes: CH₃CH₂OH + [O] → CH₃CHO + H₂O (ethanol se ethanal).
• Secondary alcohols sirf ketones (garam karne par): CH₃CH(OH)CH₃ + [O] → CH₃COCH₃ + H₂O (propan-2-ol se propanone).
• Tertiary alcohols oxidise nahi hote.

Rang ki tabdeeli: alcohol ke oxidation par orange dichromate ions (Cr₂O₇²⁻) reduce ho kar green Cr³⁺ ions bante hain.

Acid ki zaroorat: oxidising agent ban-ne ke liye dichromate khud reduce hota hai; is reduction ko H⁺ ions chahiye jo acidic medium deta hai.

Test: propan-1-ol (primary) aur propan-2-ol (secondary) orange solution ko green karte hain; 2-methylpropan-2-ol (tertiary) se rang nahi badalta. Yun test se primary ya secondary alcohol ki mojoodgi pata chalti hai.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, only the oxidation of primary and secondary alcohols will change the colour of acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ solution

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: oxidation ke liye -OH wale carbon par kam az kam aik H chahiye. Primary (CH₂OH) aur secondary (CHOH) mein yeh H hai, tertiary (COH) mein nahi, is liye tertiary alcohol orange rang ko green nahi karta.

blocks.prompt:
13 In the preparation of phenol from phenylamine, explain the purpose of: (i) making nitrous acid in situ from NaNO₂ and HCl (ii) using ice to keep the mixture below 10°C (iii) warming in the final step (iv) the reagent used in the final step. Give the equations. (4 marks)
(Phenylamine se phenol ki tayyari mein in ka maqsad wazeh karein: (i) NaNO₂ aur HCl se nitrous acid in situ banana (ii) barf se mixture ko 10°C se kam rakhna (iii) aakhri step mein garam karna (iv) aakhri step ka reagent. Equations bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Phenols phenylamine aur nitrous acid (HNO₂) se teen steps mein bante hain.

(i) HNO₂ itna ghair-mustahkam hai ke rakha nahi ja sakta; zaroorat par test-tube mein banaya jata hai: NaNO₂ + HCl → HNO₂ + NaCl.

(ii) Barf se 10°C se kam rakha jata hai kyun ke HNO₂ ghair-mustahkam hai aur phenylamine se banne wala diazonium salt bhi ghair-mustahkam hai:
C₆H₅NH₂ + HNO₂ + HCl → C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + 2H₂O

(iii) Mazeed garam karne par diazonium salt toot (hydrolyse) kar phenol aur nitrogen gas deta hai:
C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + H₂O → C₆H₅OH + N₂ + HCl

(iv) Paani: diazonium salt ke solution ko paani ke saath garam karne se woh hydrolyse ho kar phenol deta hai (equation (iii) mein). Kitab ki 22.5 wali scheme mein yahan NaOH chhapa hai, jo sahi nahi (Book correction).

book_ref.quote: The HNO₂ is so unstable that it needs to be prepared in a test-tube by reacting sodium nitrite (NaNO₂) and dilute hydrochloric acid (HCl) while keeping the temperature below 10°C using ice.

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe the reactions of the -OH group of phenol with (i) sodium hydroxide (ii) sodium metal (iii) ethanoyl chloride, giving balanced equations and the role of the base in (iii). (4 marks)
(Phenol ke -OH group ke (i) sodium hydroxide (ii) sodium metal (iii) ethanoyl chloride ke saath reactions balanced equations ke saath bayan karein aur (iii) mein base ka kirdaar batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Phenol ka -OH group halka acidic hai, is liye phenol acid-base reactions karta hai.

(i) Bases ke saath: phenol paani mein kam hal hota hai (bara non-polar ring) magar alkali mein hal ho kar hal hone wala salt aur paani banata hai.
C₆H₅OH + NaOH → C₆H₅ONa + H₂O

(ii) Reactive metals ke saath: pighla hua phenol sodium se tezi se react karta hai; salt banta hai aur hydrogen gas nikalti hai.
2C₆H₅OH + 2Na → 2C₆H₅ONa + H₂

(iii) Acyl chloride ke saath: phenol ko base ki mojoodgi mein ethanoyl chloride ke saath garam karne par ester phenyl ethanoate banta hai.
CH₃COCl + C₆H₅OH → CH₃COOC₆H₅ + HCl
Base ka kirdaar: yeh phenol se proton nikal kar phenoxide ion banata hai (C₆H₅OH + OH⁻ → C₆H₅O⁻ + H₂O). Phenoxide ion phenol se behtar nucleophile hai aur ethanoyl chloride ke carbonyl carbon par hamla karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The -OH group in phenols has a slightly acidic character It can therefore act as an acid and take part in acid-base reactions.

blocks.prompt:
15 18.8 g of molten phenol reacts completely with sodium: 2C₆H₅OH + 2Na → 2C₆H₅ONa + H₂. Calculate (i) the mass of sodium used (ii) the mass of sodium phenoxide formed (iii) the volume of hydrogen at STP. (Molar masses: phenol 94, Na 23, sodium phenoxide 116 g mol⁻¹; molar volume at STP 22.4 dm³ mol⁻¹.) (4 marks)
(18.8 g pighla hua phenol sodium se poora react karta hai: 2C₆H₅OH + 2Na → 2C₆H₅ONa + H₂. Maloom karein (i) istemal hone wale sodium ki mass (ii) banne wale sodium phenoxide ki mass (iii) STP par hydrogen ka volume. (Molar masses: phenol 94, Na 23, sodium phenoxide 116 g mol⁻¹; STP par molar volume 22.4 dm³ mol⁻¹.))
blocks.explanation: Phenol, Na aur sodium phenoxide 1 : 1 : 1 ratio mein hain; H₂ phenol ke moles ka aadha hai.

book_ref.quote: Now, a soluble salt is formed and hydrogen gas is given off.

steps: Na ke moles = 0.20 mol; Na ki mass = 0.20 × 23 = 4.6 g
C₆H₅ONa ke moles = 0.20 mol; mass = 0.20 × 116 = 23.2 g
H₂ ke moles = 0.20 ÷ 2 = 0.10 mol; STP par volume = 0.10 × 22.4 = 2.24 dm³
blocks.final_answer: (i) 4.6 g Na (ii) 23.2 g sodium phenoxide (iii) STP par 2.24 dm³ H₂

blocks.prompt:
16 Explain how the -OH group activates the benzene ring of phenol and where it directs electrophiles. Describe the bromination of phenol with its observation and equation, and contrast it with the bromination of benzene. (4 marks)
(Wazeh karein ke -OH group phenol ki benzene ring ko kaise activate karta hai aur electrophiles ko kahan bhejta hai. Phenol ki bromination mushahide aur equation ke saath bayan karein aur benzene ki bromination se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Activation: -OH group ka oxygen ring mein electron density deta hai. Is ka aik lone pair benzene ring ke π system se overlap kar ke phail jata hai aur ring ki electron density barh jati hai. Is liye ring par electrophile ka hamla aasaan hota hai (ring activated hai). Aane wale electrophiles 2, 4 aur 6 positions par jate hain.

Phenol ki bromination: phenol room temperature par bina catalyst bromine water se electrophilic substitution karta hai. Orange bromine solution be-rang ho jata hai aur 2,4,6-tribromophenol ka safed precipitate banta hai.
C₆H₅OH + 3Br₂ → C₆H₂Br₃OH + 3HBr

Benzene: is ki bromination sirf khaalis bromine (solution nahi) aur anhydrous aluminium bromide (AlBr₃) catalyst ke saath room temperature par hoti hai. Phenol activated hone ki wajah se bina catalyst bromine water se foran react karta hai.

book_ref.quote: One of the lone pairs of the oxygen atom overlaps with the π system of the benzene ring and becomes delocalised, causing an increased electron density in the aromatic ring.

blocks.prompt:
17 Excess bromine water is added to a solution containing 4.7 g of phenol: C₆H₅OH + 3Br₂ → C₆H₂Br₃OH + 3HBr. Calculate the mass of bromine that reacts and the mass of white precipitate formed. (Molar masses: phenol 94, Br₂ 160, 2,4,6-tribromophenol 331 g mol⁻¹.) (4 marks)
(4.7 g phenol wale solution mein zaa'id bromine water dala jata hai: C₆H₅OH + 3Br₂ → C₆H₂Br₃OH + 3HBr. React hone wali bromine ki mass aur banne wale safed precipitate ki mass maloom karein. (Molar masses: phenol 94, Br₂ 160, 2,4,6-tribromophenol 331 g mol⁻¹.))
blocks.explanation: Phenol limiting reactant hai; har mole 3 mol Br₂ leta hai aur 1 mol 2,4,6-tribromophenol (safed precipitate) deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Phenols also undergo electrophilic substitution reactions when reacted with bromine water at room temperature.

steps: React hone wali Br₂ ke moles = 3 × 0.050 = 0.15 mol; mass = 0.15 × 160 = 24 g
blocks.final_answer: 24 g Br₂ react karti hai; taqreeban 16.6 g 2,4,6-tribromophenol banta hai

blocks.prompt:
18 What is a phenolic compound? Explain, with 1-naphthol as the example, how the -OH group affects the reactivity of the naphthalene ring and where electrophiles attack. How does 1-naphthol behave towards bromine water? (4 marks)
(Phenolic compound kya hai? 1-naphthol ki misaal se wazeh karein ke -OH group naphthalene ring ki reactivity par kya asar dalta hai aur electrophiles kahan hamla karte hain. 1-naphthol bromine water ke saath kaisa ravaiya rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Phenolic compounds phenol (C₆H₅OH) ke ilawa woh compounds hain jin mein hydroxyl group aromatic ring se juda ho; 1-naphthol aur 2-naphthol misaalein hain.

• 1-naphthol mein hydroxy group naphthalene ki position 1 par juda hai.
• Phenol ki tarah is ka -OH electron deta hai: O ka lone pair ring mein phailta hai, is liye naphthalene ring electrophilic substitution ke liye activated hoti hai.
• Electrophiles 2 aur/ya 4 positions par jate hain.
• 1-naphthol aur doosre phenolic compounds phenol ki tarah react karte hain; maslan 1-naphthol bromine water se bromination karta hai aur bromine activated 2 aur/ya 4 positions par lagti hai.

book_ref.quote: 1-naphthol and other phenolic compounds react in a similar way as phenol.

blocks.prompt:
19 Compare ethanol and phenol in a table: where the -OH group is attached, acidity relative to water, reaction with sodium, reaction with bromine water, and one method of preparation. (4 marks)
(Ethanol aur phenol ka table mein muqabla karein: -OH kahan juda hai, paani ke muqable mein acidity, sodium se reaction, bromine water se reaction, aur tayyari ka aik tareeqa.)
blocks.explanation: Dono hydroxy compounds hain, magar phenol mein polar OH group aur electron se bharpoor ring dono react karte hain:

book_ref.quote: Phenols can undergo many types of reactions as both the electron-rich benzene ring and the polar OH group can participate in chemical reactions.

rows: Paani se kam acidic (alkyl group ethoxide ko ghair-mustahkam karta hai)
Paani se ziyada acidic (phenoxide delocalisation se mustahkam)
Ring nahi, is liye bromine water se substitution nahi
Bromine water be-rang; 2,4,6-tribromophenol ka safed precipitate
Phenylamine + HNO₂ se, diazonium salt ke zariye
